optional_improvements: Section 8.3 attributes floor stability scores (std=0.90, range 25.9-28.4) to 'the floor model' but these per-split scores are from the lightgbm_sqrt constituent (model_selection.json holdout_strategy.stability); the NNLS floor stack itself has no per-split breakdown. A precise attribution would say 'the best floor constituent (LightGBM-sqrt)' to avoid confusion.

Section 10 does not mention the MissingnessAuditor tooling warning from data_profile.json summary_warnings, though this is a pipeline note rather than a data limitation and its omission does not affect correctness.
